Ibyo wiboneye byanditswe uko igihe cyagiye gihita.
Nta makuru ahagije aracyaboneka yo kwerekana uko ururenda rwo mu nkondo y'umura ruhinduka.
Uko bisomwa: uko umurongo uba muremure, ni ko icyo wiboneye kiba hafi y'ubwoko bwa “{{eggWhite}}” — uhereye ibumoso ugana iburyo: {{dry}}, {{sticky}}, {{creamy}}, {{watery}}, {{eggWhite}}.

conceptionOnboarding.tryingDuration.titl: Umaze igihe kingana iki ugerageza gusama?
conceptionOnboarding.tryingDuration.info: Urugendo rwa buri wese rurihariye. AWA iri hano kugushyigikira kuri buri ntambwe.
Ese usanzwe umenya igihe uri muri ovulation?
Nzi neza kumenya ibimenyetso bya ovulation yanjye.
Si buri gihe mbyizeye, ariko mfite utuntu tw'ibimenyetso.
Nta kibazo niba utarabimenya. AWA izagufasha kwitegereza ukwezi kwawe uko igihe gihita.
conceptionOnboarding.indicators.title: Ni ibihe bimenyetso wifuza gukurikirana?
conceptionOnboarding.indicators.subtitle: Hitamo ibigufasha cyane gusobanukirwa uburumbuke bwawe.
Pima ubushyuhe bwawe buri gitondo kugira ngo ukurikirane uko buhinduka.
Itegereze uko buhinduka mu kwezi kwawe kose.
Andika LH test zawe kugira ngo ukurikirane izamuka rya ovulation.
Andika aya makuru mu ibanga kandi mu bwitonzi.
conceptionOnboarding.indicators.info: Amakuru yerekeye ubuzima bwawe bwite bw'igitsina aguma ari ibanga kandi ashobora kurindwa n'igenamiterere ryawe ry'ubuzima bwite.
